department: Institute of Physics and Astronomy (Faculty II)

deadline.value: No application deadline is published; the faculty asks applicants to register their intention to pursue a doctorate as early as possible.
deadline.quote: Please register your intention to pursue a doctorate as early as possible

gre_subject.value: The Faculty II doctorate pages do not mention a Physics GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: You must submit a doctoral agreement with your supervisor when you register your intention to pursue a doctorate.
supervisor.quote: In addition, please also submit a doctoral agreement with the supervising person.

funding.value: The Faculty II doctorate pages do not say whether PhD students in this field are funded.

entry_route.value: A master's degree or an equivalent degree in the subject area is the formal prerequisite; academically outstanding bachelor's holders can be admitted by a qualification procedure.
entry_route.quote: Formal prerequisite for the doctoral degree is the successful completion of a Master's program or an equivalent degree in the subject area of the respective doctoral degree.

also.quote: Academically outstanding candidates with a bachelor’s degree can be directly admitted to a doctoral degree on the basis ... of a qualification procedure

notes: Faculty II (Mathematics and Natural Sciences) runs its own regulations, dated 15 June 2022, for Dr. rer. nat. and Dr.-Ing. Its doctoral-programs list names three physics programmes: BOS.QT, SALSA and IMPRS (Elementary Processes in Physical Chemistry). BOS.QT admits by faculty nomination and takes applications twice a year, decided on a rolling basis: https://blogs.tu-berlin.de/ioap_bosqt/program/admission-regulations/ . The physics department page has no doctoral admission rules. No astronomy PhD rule was found, so astronomy is not listed.
